ios.desc:
GifForge helps you turn videos into GIFs directly on your device.

Create short GIFs from screen recordings, demos, and clips with simple controls for trim, export size, frame rate, and quality. Video processing stays local on-device by default, so you can work privately without uploading your source video to a server.

Features:
- Convert video to GIF locally
- Trim start and end time
- Adjust export size, frame rate, and quality
- Export GIF and MP4
- Private-by-default workflow
- Pro subscription for higher export limits and advanced output settings

GifForge Pro is available as an auto-renewable subscription with monthly and yearly options.
